newsitem.title: UK: M&S plans challenge to supermarkets -paper.
newsitem.headline: M&S plans challenge to supermarkets -paper.

text.p: Leading British retailer Marks and Spencer Plc is planning to expand its range of food products this year, in a challenge to the major supermarket chains, the Sunday Times said.
New services are expected to include in-store bakeries and the sale of a range of basic ingredients and products such as flour, the paper said.
M&S is attempting to encourage customers to view it as an alternative to large retailers, rather than a specialist supplier of premium products, the Sunday Times said.
However, a spokeswoman for M&S said the company was "not in the same game" as the supermarkets, and that many stores already had the facilities mentioned in the newspaper article.
